findings.text: follow-on: the assertion compares the admitted pointer's backend against LOCAL_BACKEND, the exact lane handed to admit_once at :261, and admit_once admits only pointers whose backend equals the lane it drains, so the assertion holds for any admitted run and cannot catch a regression in the assertion it names.

follow-on: the regression check states the file gives the same 12 pass ids at head, but its cited head-rereview.log stops after 8 of 12 tests with no summary line and no EXIT=, so the head side of the done_when's regression clause is claimed rather than recorded; the same manifest at :90 says zero failures were observed with no FAILED line while base-subset.log and head-subset.log each record an F.

follow-on: the plan's done-when names a reflex-review fixture with the metered backend in review_excluded_backends and directs the node to stop and report rather than change code when that fixture does not reproduce; the node reports it does not reproduce and edits reckon/crew/dispatch.py anyway on a substituted re-dispatch reproduction, so a coordinator must adjudicate whether that substitution is accepted.

item_verdicts.diff: read 3d651787d7f4 against its parent e21947c41b44; it adds a 14-line queued-backend carry in reckon/crew/dispatch.py, a 275-line test file and a 4-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the plan names a reflex-review fixture with the metered backend in review_excluded_backends; tests/test_a_queued_run_waits_on_its_lane.py:207-273 reproduces a re-dispatch of an already-queued request instead, and head-gate.log records 2 passed while negative-control.log is red at EXIT=1.

item_verdicts.write_paths: prompt.txt grants reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py, reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py, tests/test_a_queued_run_waits_on_its_lane.py and the fragment; git show 3d651787d7f4 changes dispatch.py, the new test and the fragment only.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_queued_run_waits_on_its_lane.py:230 fails with the fix reverted (negative-control.log), so it guards the re-queue lane, but the admission test's assertion at :273 moves with the value it tests.
justifications.evidence: head-gate.log records 2 passed and negative-control.log is red at EXIT=1, but the manifest's regression clause rests on head-rereview.log, which stops after 8 of 12 tests with no summary and no EXIT= line.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1146-1156 keeps the module's existing idiom of a single guarded local that feeds _queued_request_record, and neither the new symbol queued_backend_name nor the new test file carries a plan or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1152-1156 stops the re-queue from rewriting the lane a waiting request was queued on, which is the one path by which a request queued on clive could come to record codex, though the plan's named review_excluded_backends fixture was not the reproduction.
justifications.reuse: the capability search over reckon/crew found no owner that carries a queued request's backend across a re-queue; _queued_request_record at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:225 remains the single builder and the change routes the existing recorded value through it with no new definition.
